infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

pageDetails.para11_1: In accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (GDPR), we inform you that:
pageDetails.para11_2: 1. The Administrator, within the meaning of Article 4(7) of the GDPR, of your personal data is the Minister of Foreign Affairs with its registered office in Poland, in Warsaw (00-580), Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, while performing the duties of the Administrator is the Consul of the Republic of Poland in New Delhi with its registered office in New Delhi, 50-M Shantipath, Chanakyapuri, 110 021 (India).
pageDetails.para11_3: 2. The Processor who, at the request of the Administrator, processes personal data as part of visa outsourcing is VFS Global Services Private Limited with its registered office in Mumbai, 19th Floor, Tower A, Urmi Estate 95, Ganpatrao Kadam Marg, Lower Parel West, Maharashtra, 400013 (India). The data is transferred in accordance with Article 46 GDPR.
pageDetails.para11_4: 3. The Minister of Foreign Affairs has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) who performs his duties in relation to data processed in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and foreign missions.
pageDetails.para11_6: address: Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, 00-580 Warsaw
pageDetails.para11_8: 4. The scope of personal data processed includes the data contained in the visa application and in the passport document.
pageDetails.para11_9: 5. The personal data has been provided directly or, in the case of minors, through a parent or legal guardian.
pageDetails.para11_10: 6. The data is processed on the basis of the information contained in Article 6(1)(c) of the GDPR and Article 9(2)(g) of the GDPR in order to carry out the process of issuing a visa decision with the participation of the Processor on the basis of the following provisions of law:
pageDetails.para11_11: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 July 2009 establishing a Community Code on Visas,
pageDetails.para11_14: Regulation (EC) No 1987/2006 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II) and Council Decision 2007/533/JHAC of 12 June 2007 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II).                 Regulation (EC) No 767/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 July 2008 concerning the Visa Information System (VIS) and the exchange of data between Member States on short-stay visas (VIS Regulation)
pageDetails.para11_15: 7. Personal data will be processed for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which they were collected, i.e., issuing and delivering the visa decision, and then stored for archival purposes in accordance with the law and internal regulations.
pageDetails.para11_16: 8. The data is protected under the GDPR and cannot be made available to third parties who are not authorized to access the data.
pageDetails.para11_17: 9. Your data may be made available to relevant entities, including public authorities, on the basis of legal provisions. With regard to the verification within the framework of SIS II, the competent administrator of personal data is the Chief Commander of the Police COT KSI, 148/150 Pulawska Street, 02-624 Warsaw.(https://kgp.bip.policja.gov.pl/kgp/centralny-organ-techni/40172,Centralny-Organ-Techniczny-Krajowego-Systemu-Informatycznego-Komendant-Glowny-Po.html).
pageDetails.para11_18: 10. Providing your personal data is a statutory requirement and is necessary to consider the case.
pageDetails.para11_19: 11. Unless specific provisions provide otherwise, you have the right to control the processing of your data, as defined in Articles 15-19 of the GDPR, in particular the right to access your data and to rectify, delete or limit processing.
pageDetails.para11_20: 12. Your data will not be processed in an automated manner that will affect the decision-making process that may have legal effects or similarly significantly affect it. The data will not be profiled.
pageDetails.para11_21: 13. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority at the following address:
pageDetails.para11_22: President of the Office for Personal Data Protection

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

pageDetails.para11_1: In accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (GDPR), we inform you that:
pageDetails.para11_2: 1. The Administrator, within the meaning of Article 4(7) of the GDPR, of your personal data is the Minister of Foreign Affairs with its registered office in Poland, in Warsaw (00-580), Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, while performing the duties of the Administrator is the Consul of the Republic of Poland in New Delhi with its registered office in New Delhi, 50-M Shantipath, Chanakyapuri, 110 021 (India).
pageDetails.para11_3: 2. The Processor who, at the request of the Administrator, processes personal data as part of visa outsourcing is VFS Global Services Private Limited with its registered office in Mumbai, 19th Floor, Tower A, Urmi Estate 95, Ganpatrao Kadam Marg, Lower Parel West, Maharashtra, 400013 (India). The data is transferred in accordance with Article 46 GDPR.
pageDetails.para11_4: 3. The Minister of Foreign Affairs has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) who performs his duties in relation to data processed in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and foreign missions.
pageDetails.para11_6: address: Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, 00-580 Warsaw
pageDetails.para11_8: 4. The scope of personal data processed includes the data contained in the visa application and in the passport document.
pageDetails.para11_9: 5. The personal data has been provided directly or, in the case of minors, through a parent or legal guardian.
pageDetails.para11_10: 6. The data is processed on the basis of the information contained in Article 6(1)(c) of the GDPR and Article 9(2)(g) of the GDPR in order to carry out the process of issuing a visa decision with the participation of the Processor on the basis of the following provisions of law:
pageDetails.para11_11: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 July 2009 establishing a Community Code on Visas,
pageDetails.para11_14: Regulation (EC) No 1987/2006 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II) and Council Decision 2007/533/JHAC of 12 June 2007 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II).                 Regulation (EC) No 767/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 July 2008 concerning the Visa Information System (VIS) and the exchange of data between Member States on short-stay visas (VIS Regulation)
pageDetails.para11_15: 7. Personal data will be processed for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which they were collected, i.e., issuing and delivering the visa decision, and then stored for archival purposes in accordance with the law and internal regulations.
pageDetails.para11_16: 8. The data is protected under the GDPR and cannot be made available to third parties who are not authorized to access the data.
pageDetails.para11_17: 9. Your data may be made available to relevant entities, including public authorities, on the basis of legal provisions. With regard to the verification within the framework of SIS II, the competent administrator of personal data is the Chief Commander of the Police COT KSI, 148/150 Pulawska Street, 02-624 Warsaw.(https://kgp.bip.policja.gov.pl/kgp/centralny-organ-techni/40172,Centralny-Organ-Techniczny-Krajowego-Systemu-Informatycznego-Komendant-Glowny-Po.html).
pageDetails.para11_18: 10. Providing your personal data is a statutory requirement and is necessary to consider the case.
pageDetails.para11_19: 11. Unless specific provisions provide otherwise, you have the right to control the processing of your data, as defined in Articles 15-19 of the GDPR, in particular the right to access your data and to rectify, delete or limit processing.
pageDetails.para11_20: 12. Your data will not be processed in an automated manner that will affect the decision-making process that may have legal effects or similarly significantly affect it. The data will not be profiled.
pageDetails.para11_21: 13. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority at the following address:
pageDetails.para11_22: President of the Office for Personal Data Protection

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

pageDetails.para11_1: In accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (GDPR), we inform you that:
pageDetails.para11_2: 1. The Administrator, within the meaning of Article 4(7) of the GDPR, of your personal data is the Minister of Foreign Affairs with its registered office in Poland, in Warsaw (00-580), Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, while performing the duties of the Administrator is the Consul of the Republic of Poland in New Delhi with its registered office in New Delhi, 50-M Shantipath, Chanakyapuri, 110 021 (India).
pageDetails.para11_3: 2. The Processor who, at the request of the Administrator, processes personal data as part of visa outsourcing is VFS Global Services Private Limited with its registered office in Mumbai, 19th Floor, Tower A, Urmi Estate 95, Ganpatrao Kadam Marg, Lower Parel West, Maharashtra, 400013 (India). The data is transferred in accordance with Article 46 GDPR.
pageDetails.para11_4: 3. The Minister of Foreign Affairs has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) who performs his duties in relation to data processed in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and foreign missions.
pageDetails.para11_6: address: Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, 00-580 Warsaw
pageDetails.para11_8: 4. The scope of personal data processed includes the data contained in the visa application and in the passport document.
pageDetails.para11_9: 5. The personal data has been provided directly or, in the case of minors, through a parent or legal guardian.
pageDetails.para11_10: 6. The data is processed on the basis of the information contained in Article 6(1)(c) of the GDPR and Article 9(2)(g) of the GDPR in order to carry out the process of issuing a visa decision with the participation of the Processor on the basis of the following provisions of law:
pageDetails.para11_11: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 July 2009 establishing a Community Code on Visas,
pageDetails.para11_14: Regulation (EC) No 1987/2006 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II) and Council Decision 2007/533/JHAC of 12 June 2007 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II).                 Regulation (EC) No 767/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 July 2008 concerning the Visa Information System (VIS) and the exchange of data between Member States on short-stay visas (VIS Regulation)
pageDetails.para11_15: 7. Personal data will be processed for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which they were collected, i.e., issuing and delivering the visa decision, and then stored for archival purposes in accordance with the law and internal regulations.
pageDetails.para11_16: 8. The data is protected under the GDPR and cannot be made available to third parties who are not authorized to access the data.

pageDetails.para1: Form Filling Service
pageDetails.para2: Get end-to-end assistance in completing your visa application form correctly.
pageDetails.para3: Our trained experts can assist you with filling in your visa application form. Upload your details
pageDetails.para4: and supporting documents online and let our team do the rest. Our in-house experts will fill in the required details and check the form and supporting documents for completeness and accuracy before you submit your visa application.
pageDetails.para6: With our expert staff to assist you, Form filling is quick and easy with just three simple steps.

pageDetails.para9: Step 2

pageDetails.para13: Service Fees

pageDetails.para17: Frequently Asked Questions
pageDetails.para18: 1. What is a Form Filling service?
pageDetails.para19: Our Form Filling service offers you end-to-end professional assistance and guidance with your visa application form, leaving you rest assured that your documents and details are in order to submit your visa application.
pageDetails.para20: 2. Which countries do you offer services for?
pageDetails.para21: This service is currently available for applicants from India travelling to Austria, Hungary, Malta, Poland and Switzerland.
pageDetails.para22: 2. How do I submit my forms and supporting documents?
pageDetails.para23: Once you opt for the service and make a payment, you can upload your documents online.
pageDetails.para24: 3. How do I make payment?
pageDetails.para25: You can make a payment online at the time of booking the service. Please note, opting for this service does not have any bearing on the decision or timeline of your visa application. This is the sole prerogative of the respective Embassy/Consulate.
pageDetails.para26: You will shortly receive an email confirming your payment and explaining next steps.

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

pageDetails.para1: Form Filling Service
pageDetails.para2: Get end-to-end assistance in completing your visa application form correctly.
pageDetails.para3: Our trained experts can assist you with filling in your visa application form. Upload your details
pageDetails.para4: and supporting documents online and let our team do the rest. Our in-house experts will fill in the required details and check the form and supporting documents for completeness and accuracy before you submit your visa application.
pageDetails.para6: With our expert staff to assist you, Form filling is quick and easy with just three simple steps.
pageDetails.para7: Step 1
pageDetails.para8: Book the service and make a payment.
pageDetails.para9: Step 2
pageDetails.para12: Have your form duly filled by our team.
pageDetails.para13: Service Fees
pageDetails.para14: Fee Type

pageDetails.para17: Frequently Asked Questions
pageDetails.para18: 1. What is a Form Filling service?
pageDetails.para19: Our Form Filling service offers you end-to-end professional assistance and guidance with your visa application form, leaving you rest assured that your documents and details are in order to submit your visa application.
pageDetails.para20: 2. Which countries do you offer services for?
pageDetails.para21: This service is currently available for applicants from India travelling to Austria, Hungary, Malta, Poland and Switzerland.
pageDetails.para22: 2. How do I submit my forms and supporting documents?
pageDetails.para23: Once you opt for the service and make a payment, you can upload your documents online.
pageDetails.para24: 3. How do I make payment?
pageDetails.para25: You can make a payment online at the time of booking the service. Please note, opting for this service does not have any bearing on the decision or timeline of your visa application. This is the sole prerogative of the respective Embassy/Consulate.
pageDetails.para26: You will shortly receive an email confirming your payment and explaining next steps.

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

pageDetails.para11_1: In accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (GDPR), we inform you that:
pageDetails.para11_2: 1. The Administrator, within the meaning of Article 4(7) of the GDPR, of your personal data is the Minister of Foreign Affairs with its registered office in Poland, in Warsaw (00-580), Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, while performing the duties of the Administrator is the Consul of the Republic of Poland in New Delhi with its registered office in New Delhi, 50-M Shantipath, Chanakyapuri, 110 021 (India).
pageDetails.para11_3: 2. The Processor who, at the request of the Administrator, processes personal data as part of visa outsourcing is VFS Global Services Private Limited with its registered office in Mumbai, 19th Floor, Tower A, Urmi Estate 95, Ganpatrao Kadam Marg, Lower Parel West, Maharashtra, 400013 (India). The data is transferred in accordance with Article 46 GDPR.
pageDetails.para11_4: 3. The Minister of Foreign Affairs has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) who performs his duties in relation to data processed in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and foreign missions.
pageDetails.para11_6: address: Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, 00-580 Warsaw
pageDetails.para11_8: 4. The scope of personal data processed includes the data contained in the visa application and in the passport document.
pageDetails.para11_9: 5. The personal data has been provided directly or, in the case of minors, through a parent or legal guardian.
pageDetails.para11_10: 6. The data is processed on the basis of the information contained in Article 6(1)(c) of the GDPR and Article 9(2)(g) of the GDPR in order to carry out the process of issuing a visa decision with the participation of the Processor on the basis of the following provisions of law:
pageDetails.para11_11: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 July 2009 establishing a Community Code on Visas,
pageDetails.para11_14: Regulation (EC) No 1987/2006 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II) and Council Decision 2007/533/JHAC of 12 June 2007 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II).                 Regulation (EC) No 767/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 July 2008 concerning the Visa Information System (VIS) and the exchange of data between Member States on short-stay visas (VIS Regulation)
pageDetails.para11_15: 7. Personal data will be processed for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which they were collected, i.e., issuing and delivering the visa decision, and then stored for archival purposes in accordance with the law and internal regulations.
pageDetails.para11_16: 8. The data is protected under the GDPR and cannot be made available to third parties who are not authorized to access the data.
pageDetails.para11_17: 9. Your data may be made available to relevant entities, including public authorities, on the basis of legal provisions. With regard to the verification within the framework of SIS II, the competent administrator of personal data is the Chief Commander of the Police COT KSI, 148/150 Pulawska Street, 02-624 Warsaw.(https://kgp.bip.policja.gov.pl/kgp/centralny-organ-techni/40172,Centralny-Organ-Techniczny-Krajowego-Systemu-Informatycznego-Komendant-Glowny-Po.html).
pageDetails.para11_18: 10. Providing your personal data is a statutory requirement and is necessary to consider the case.
pageDetails.para11_19: 11. Unless specific provisions provide otherwise, you have the right to control the processing of your data, as defined in Articles 15-19 of the GDPR, in particular the right to access your data and to rectify, delete or limit processing.
pageDetails.para11_20: 12. Your data will not be processed in an automated manner that will affect the decision-making process that may have legal effects or similarly significantly affect it. The data will not be profiled.
pageDetails.para11_21: 13. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority at the following address:
pageDetails.para11_22: President of the Office for Personal Data Protection

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

pageDetails.para11_1: In accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (GDPR), we inform you that:
pageDetails.para11_2: 1. The Administrator, within the meaning of Article 4(7) of the GDPR, of your personal data is the Minister of Foreign Affairs with its registered office in Poland, in Warsaw (00-580), Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, while performing the duties of the Administrator is the Consul of the Republic of Poland in New Delhi with its registered office in New Delhi, 50-M Shantipath, Chanakyapuri, 110 021 (India).
pageDetails.para11_3: 2. The Processor who, at the request of the Administrator, processes personal data as part of visa outsourcing is VFS Global Services Private Limited with its registered office in Mumbai, 19th Floor, Tower A, Urmi Estate 95, Ganpatrao Kadam Marg, Lower Parel West, Maharashtra, 400013 (India). The data is transferred in accordance with Article 46 GDPR.
pageDetails.para11_4: 3. The Minister of Foreign Affairs has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) who performs his duties in relation to data processed in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and foreign missions.
pageDetails.para11_6: address: Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, 00-580 Warsaw
pageDetails.para11_8: 4. The scope of personal data processed includes the data contained in the visa application and in the passport document.
pageDetails.para11_9: 5. The personal data has been provided directly or, in the case of minors, through a parent or legal guardian.
pageDetails.para11_10: 6. The data is processed on the basis of the information contained in Article 6(1)(c) of the GDPR and Article 9(2)(g) of the GDPR in order to carry out the process of issuing a visa decision with the participation of the Processor on the basis of the following provisions of law:
pageDetails.para11_11: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 July 2009 establishing a Community Code on Visas,
pageDetails.para11_14: Regulation (EC) No 1987/2006 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II) and Council Decision 2007/533/JHAC of 12 June 2007 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II).                 Regulation (EC) No 767/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 July 2008 concerning the Visa Information System (VIS) and the exchange of data between Member States on short-stay visas (VIS Regulation)
pageDetails.para11_15: 7. Personal data will be processed for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which they were collected, i.e., issuing and delivering the visa decision, and then stored for archival purposes in accordance with the law and internal regulations.
pageDetails.para11_16: 8. The data is protected under the GDPR and cannot be made available to third parties who are not authorized to access the data.
pageDetails.para11_17: 9. Your data may be made available to relevant entities, including public authorities, on the basis of legal provisions. With regard to the verification within the framework of SIS II, the competent administrator of personal data is the Chief Commander of the Police COT KSI, 148/150 Pulawska Street, 02-624 Warsaw.(https://kgp.bip.policja.gov.pl/kgp/centralny-organ-techni/40172,Centralny-Organ-Techniczny-Krajowego-Systemu-Informatycznego-Komendant-Glowny-Po.html).
pageDetails.para11_18: 10. Providing your personal data is a statutory requirement and is necessary to consider the case.
pageDetails.para11_19: 11. Unless specific provisions provide otherwise, you have the right to control the processing of your data, as defined in Articles 15-19 of the GDPR, in particular the right to access your data and to rectify, delete or limit processing.
pageDetails.para11_20: 12. Your data will not be processed in an automated manner that will affect the decision-making process that may have legal effects or similarly significantly affect it. The data will not be profiled.
pageDetails.para11_21: 13. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority at the following address:
pageDetails.para11_22: President of the Office for Personal Data Protection

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

pageDetails.para11_1: In accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (GDPR), we inform you that:
pageDetails.para11_2: 1. The Administrator, within the meaning of Article 4(7) of the GDPR, of your personal data is the Minister of Foreign Affairs with its registered office in Poland, in Warsaw (00-580), Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, while performing the duties of the Administrator is the Consul of the Republic of Poland in New Delhi with its registered office in New Delhi, 50-M Shantipath, Chanakyapuri, 110 021 (India).
pageDetails.para11_3: 2. The Processor who, at the request of the Administrator, processes personal data as part of visa outsourcing is VFS Global Services Private Limited with its registered office in Mumbai, 19th Floor, Tower A, Urmi Estate 95, Ganpatrao Kadam Marg, Lower Parel West, Maharashtra, 400013 (India). The data is transferred in accordance with Article 46 GDPR.
pageDetails.para11_4: 3. The Minister of Foreign Affairs has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) who performs his duties in relation to data processed in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and foreign missions.
pageDetails.para11_6: address: Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, 00-580 Warsaw
pageDetails.para11_8: 4. The scope of personal data processed includes the data contained in the visa application and in the passport document.
pageDetails.para11_9: 5. The personal data has been provided directly or, in the case of minors, through a parent or legal guardian.
pageDetails.para11_10: 6. The data is processed on the basis of the information contained in Article 6(1)(c) of the GDPR and Article 9(2)(g) of the GDPR in order to carry out the process of issuing a visa decision with the participation of the Processor on the basis of the following provisions of law:
pageDetails.para11_11: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 July 2009 establishing a Community Code on Visas,
pageDetails.para11_14: Regulation (EC) No 1987/2006 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II) and Council Decision 2007/533/JHAC of 12 June 2007 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II).                 Regulation (EC) No 767/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 July 2008 concerning the Visa Information System (VIS) and the exchange of data between Member States on short-stay visas (VIS Regulation)
pageDetails.para11_15: 7. Personal data will be processed for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which they were collected, i.e., issuing and delivering the visa decision, and then stored for archival purposes in accordance with the law and internal regulations.
pageDetails.para11_16: 8. The data is protected under the GDPR and cannot be made available to third parties who are not authorized to access the data.
pageDetails.para11_17: 9. Your data may be made available to relevant entities, including public authorities, on the basis of legal provisions. With regard to the verification within the framework of SIS II, the competent administrator of personal data is the Chief Commander of the Police COT KSI, 148/150 Pulawska Street, 02-624 Warsaw.(https://kgp.bip.policja.gov.pl/kgp/centralny-organ-techni/40172,Centralny-Organ-Techniczny-Krajowego-Systemu-Informatycznego-Komendant-Glowny-Po.html).
pageDetails.para11_18: 10. Providing your personal data is a statutory requirement and is necessary to consider the case.
pageDetails.para11_19: 11. Unless specific provisions provide otherwise, you have the right to control the processing of your data, as defined in Articles 15-19 of the GDPR, in particular the right to access your data and to rectify, delete or limit processing.
pageDetails.para11_20: 12. Your data will not be processed in an automated manner that will affect the decision-making process that may have legal effects or similarly significantly affect it. The data will not be profiled.
pageDetails.para11_21: 13. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority at the following address:
pageDetails.para11_22: President of the Office for Personal Data Protection

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.

pageDetails.para11_1: In accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (GDPR), we inform you that:
pageDetails.para11_2: 1. The Administrator, within the meaning of Article 4(7) of the GDPR, of your personal data is the Minister of Foreign Affairs with its registered office in Poland, in Warsaw (00-580), Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, while performing the duties of the Administrator is the Consul of the Republic of Poland in New Delhi with its registered office in New Delhi, 50-M Shantipath, Chanakyapuri, 110 021 (India).
pageDetails.para11_3: 2. The Processor who, at the request of the Administrator, processes personal data as part of visa outsourcing is VFS Global Services Private Limited with its registered office in Mumbai, 19th Floor, Tower A, Urmi Estate 95, Ganpatrao Kadam Marg, Lower Parel West, Maharashtra, 400013 (India). The data is transferred in accordance with Article 46 GDPR.
pageDetails.para11_4: 3. The Minister of Foreign Affairs has appointed a Data Protection Officer (DPO) who performs his duties in relation to data processed in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and foreign missions.
pageDetails.para11_6: address: Al. J. Ch. Szucha 23, 00-580 Warsaw
pageDetails.para11_8: 4. The scope of personal data processed includes the data contained in the visa application and in the passport document.
pageDetails.para11_9: 5. The personal data has been provided directly or, in the case of minors, through a parent or legal guardian.
pageDetails.para11_10: 6. The data is processed on the basis of the information contained in Article 6(1)(c) of the GDPR and Article 9(2)(g) of the GDPR in order to carry out the process of issuing a visa decision with the participation of the Processor on the basis of the following provisions of law:
pageDetails.para11_11: Regulation (EC) No 810/2009 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 July 2009 establishing a Community Code on Visas,
pageDetails.para11_14: Regulation (EC) No 1987/2006 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II) and Council Decision 2007/533/JHAC of 12 June 2007 on the establishment, operation and use of the second-generation Schengen Information System (SIS II).                 Regulation (EC) No 767/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 July 2008 concerning the Visa Information System (VIS) and the exchange of data between Member States on short-stay visas (VIS Regulation)
pageDetails.para11_15: 7. Personal data will be processed for the period necessary to achieve the purpose for which they were collected, i.e., issuing and delivering the visa decision, and then stored for archival purposes in accordance with the law and internal regulations.
pageDetails.para11_16: 8. The data is protected under the GDPR and cannot be made available to third parties who are not authorized to access the data.
pageDetails.para11_17: 9. Your data may be made available to relevant entities, including public authorities, on the basis of legal provisions. With regard to the verification within the framework of SIS II, the competent administrator of personal data is the Chief Commander of the Police COT KSI, 148/150 Pulawska Street, 02-624 Warsaw.(https://kgp.bip.policja.gov.pl/kgp/centralny-organ-techni/40172,Centralny-Organ-Techniczny-Krajowego-Systemu-Informatycznego-Komendant-Glowny-Po.html).
pageDetails.para11_18: 10. Providing your personal data is a statutory requirement and is necessary to consider the case.
pageDetails.para11_19: 11. Unless specific provisions provide otherwise, you have the right to control the processing of your data, as defined in Articles 15-19 of the GDPR, in particular the right to access your data and to rectify, delete or limit processing.
pageDetails.para11_20: 12. Your data will not be processed in an automated manner that will affect the decision-making process that may have legal effects or similarly significantly affect it. The data will not be profiled.
pageDetails.para11_21: 13. You have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority at the following address:
pageDetails.para11_22: President of the Office for Personal Data Protection

pageDetails.para2: Get end-to-end assistance in completing your visa application form correctly.
pageDetails.para3: Our trained experts can assist you with filling in your visa application form. Upload your details
pageDetails.para4: and supporting documents online and let our team do the rest. Our in-house experts will fill in the required details and check the form and supporting documents for completeness and accuracy before you submit your visa application.

pageDetails.para17: Frequently Asked Questions
pageDetails.para18: 1. What is a Form Filling service?
pageDetails.para19: Our Form Filling service offers you end-to-end professional assistance and guidance with your visa application form, leaving you rest assured that your documents and details are in order to submit your visa application.
pageDetails.para20: 2. Which countries do you offer services for?
pageDetails.para21: This service is currently available for applicants from India travelling to Austria, Hungary, Malta, Poland and Switzerland.
pageDetails.para22: 2. How do I submit my forms and supporting documents?
pageDetails.para23: Once you opt for the service and make a payment, you can upload your documents online.
pageDetails.para24: 3. How do I make payment?
pageDetails.para25: You can make a payment online at the time of booking the service. Please note, opting for this service does not have any bearing on the decision or timeline of your visa application. This is the sole prerogative of the respective Embassy/Consulate.

infoMessages.message1: Relax in your own private booth at the Application Centre and our experienced staff members will take care of the entire visa application process. The Platinum Lounge Service ensures submission of your visa application form, supporting documents on priority without waiting on queues and the enrolment of biometrics.
infoMessages.message2: Submit your application beyond the normal processing hours. Ideal for busy working professionals, this service allows you to apply for your visa outside of normal working hours - allowing you to visit before or after work. Once at the Application Centre, the Prime Time Appointment allows you to beat the queues - and process your visa application with ease and speed.
infoMessages.message3: Add a little extra to your application. Treat yourself to a more relaxed, more convenient experience when you visit us at the Centre. Our Premium Lounge is a tranquil retreat where you'll be greeted with a friendly welcome, ample privacy and help with whatever you need. The Premium Lounge includes • A separate lobby with personalised service from dedicated staff • Refreshments - with a range of snacks and non-alcoholic drinks for you to choose from • A photocopying service for your documents • A courier return of your passport • SMS update on the status of your application Using the Premium Lounge service does not guarantee the success of your visa application or affect the service standard.
